title: Add TestMine to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [TestMine](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/testmine) to build
- Paste source code, pick a framework, get unit tests covering happy path and edge cases. BYOP Pollinations-powered.

Fixes #14990

gist.headline: Tests bloom from paste
gist.blurb: TestMine joined the build: paste in source code, choose a framework, and let a small cloud of Pollinations-powered tests cover the obvious and the weird bits.
gist.summary: Added TestMine to the app build, giving developers a BYOP Pollinations-powered tool that turns pasted source code into framework-specific unit tests for happy paths and edge cases.
gist.impact: Developers can now discover TestMine through the Pollinations app ecosystem and generate a practical first pass of unit tests without starting from an empty test file.
gist.visual_concept: Depict TestMine as a cozy testing garden: Polli, wearing tiny safety goggles and holding a clipboard, feeds a source-code scroll into a retro terminal while neat little test-case sprouts emerge in labeled pots. Include friendly happy-path and edge-case plant markers, with code blocks on the CRT screen and flowers growing around the workstation.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden-workshop where the cute Polli bee mascot, with a yellow body, dark brown stripes, pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and tiny safety goggles, pastes a code scroll into a lime green (#ecf874) glowing retro terminal as happy-path and edge-case unit-test sprouts bloom from little pots. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, pixel-font text reading "TESTMINE", with flowers and code-vines around the desk; nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
